entries.name: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani, version 1.1)
entries.attribution: Quran text from the Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), Uthmani version 1.1, © 2007-2026 Tanzil Project, licensed under CC BY 3.0.
entries.usage_constraints: Verbatim redistribution only — the Tanzil terms forbid modifying the text. The source (Tanzil Project) must be clearly indicated with a link to tanzil.net, and the copyright notice must be reproduced in all files derived from or containing a substantial portion of the text. The import pipeline never normalises or re-splits this text; it is checksummed as the canonical reference.

entries.name: QPC Ḥafṣ Uthmani word-level script (King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex, via QUL)
entries.attribution: Word-level QPC Ḥafṣ Uthmani script published by the King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex and curated by the Quranic Universal Library (QUL, qul.tarteel.ai).
entries.usage_constraints: Registry-defined code: QUL publishes these community-curated resources for free use in Quranic applications without a single SPDX grant. Attribution to the King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex and to QUL is required on the About screen. Redistributed verbatim inside signed data packs only; no modification of the script.

entries.name: KFGQPC V1 Madani muṣḥaf layout, 604 pages / 15 lines (1405H print, via QUL)
entries.attribution: Madani muṣḥaf page and line layout (KFGQPC V1, 1405H print) published by the King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex and curated by the Quranic Universal Library (QUL, qul.tarteel.ai).
entries.usage_constraints: Registry-defined code, as for text:qpc-hafs. Modifications must be declared: this pack applies the page-offset corrections recorded in tools/pack-builder/fixtures/layout_errata.json and derives surah-name/basmallah line typing from the word placements; both are documented in the pack-builder README.

entries.name: Word-by-word English translation and transliteration (QuranWBW, via QUL)
entries.attribution: Word-by-word English glosses and transliteration from QuranWBW.com, curated by the Quranic Universal Library (QUL, qul.tarteel.ai).
entries.usage_constraints: Registry-defined code, as for text:qpc-hafs. Attribution to QuranWBW.com and QUL is required on the About screen. Glosses are aids to understanding, not a translation of record, and must be labelled as such in the UI.
